summary: Pick a file, and show chosen files as rows with size and progress.

pairs.dont: Leave the accepted format to trial and error.
pairs.do: Set accept and name the format and size limit in the hint — 'CSV, up to 10 MB'.
pairs.why: The picker greys out wrong types, but nothing says why. People need the rule before they go looking.

pairs.dont: Show only a count once files are chosen.
pairs.do: Render a FileUploadItem per file, with its size and a remove button.
pairs.why: '3 files' cannot be checked. Rows let people spot the wrong one and take it out.

pairs.dont: Use the same word for stopping an upload and removing a finished file.
pairs.do: Let FileUploadItem say Cancel while progress is running and Remove after.
pairs.why: They have different consequences, and the button's name is what a screen reader announces.

a11y: The native file input stays in the page (visually hidden), labelled by the whole field — so keyboard, accept filtering and form submission all behave natively.
Upload progress is a progressbar named 'Uploading <file>' with aria-valuenow.
